title: Forza Motorsport 2
notes: Made with the Forza importer (import_forza.py, a Blender plugin) from the game's own car archives.  Parts are the game's own names (body, bumperFa, hooda, glassLF, headlightL, interior, wheelLF ...) as children of ONE root node named like the archive; the stock car is visible.

BODY KITS (Forza Motorsport 1 / 2 / 4, Forza Horizon): every upgrade part of the shop is in the FBX, HIDDEN, at its place on the car, in Variants/<slot> (bumperF, bumperR, skirtL, skirtR, wing, hood, cage, exhaust, trunk): the game names them <part><letter>, 'a' = stock, b .. t = the tuner kits, race = the race kit.  To see them: <car>_kits.fbx = the stock car and one complete car per kit letter (the kit's parts replace the stock ones), all VISIBLE, in rows of 6.  Variants/driver = the driver mannequin (Forza 1), Variants/popup_up = pop-up lamps up.
LODs: every lower level of detail of every part (LOD2-LOD5; Forza 4 / Horizon: LOD1-LOD5 next to the LOD0 car) is HIDDEN in LODs/LOD<n>.

Left out: skeleton, locators, blur discs.  Body paint is a run time shader in all these games: one plain red (the stock paint of the first livery in Forza Motorsport), baked ambient occlusion is NOT in the FBX (it is in the plugin and in the renders).
The front of the car is +Z like in the other games; the car stands on the ground at y = 0.

Folder names are the game's archive names (maker_model_year).  Wheels: the stock wheel zip of the game (Media/wheels), placed with the car's physics data; tyre sizes from the same data.  Materials are matched by name (no shader library on the disc): lamps and the interior use the game's pictures, paint / chrome / glass are plain PBR.

RIMS: _Rims holds every file of Media/wheels (411 zips: the stock wheels of the cars and the shop wheels), rim and tyre as two objects, in the size of the file, outer face towards +X, standing on the ground, with the game's wheel pictures (hub logos).  408 of them: enkei_rs5, mht_crossover_wheel and 5zigen_hyper_5zr_02 are older carbin versions with float vertices and are left out (not decoded).
